data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'athar', meaning to be protected or sheltered. The name Mathlaa symbolizes being under the loving care and protection of Allah. The name Mathlaa carries the meaning “Protected by God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mathlaa usually hope their child will grow to embody protected by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
